items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: No. Well, I heard him once but I don't remember why it was.

ctx.x: Yeah, he used to play some of them. Yeah, Booker T was there too. Usually it's Booker T and Chester Jones. Yeah, Booker T and Chester Jones. Did you hear Earl Humphrey? Was he with them back here?
No. Well, I heard him once but I don't remember why it was. It probably was with Eureka.

Might have been. I wasn't there I don't think of course. I never go to the funerals across the river. There's just nothing but white people, you know. Yeah. I feel very bad. They make me self conscious white people.
